description: One-shot convenience tool: creates a transcode job, polls until it reaches a terminal state (completed/failed/canceled) or the timeout expires, and returns the final job plus a signed download URL if completed. Use this when you want the full transcode in one step without managing polling yourself.

inputs.description: One to ten input videos. Multiple inputs are concatenated in order.

options.description: Advanced mode — raw FFmpeg options or virtual options. Overrides `preset`.

argument.description: Flag value, or an object for virtual options.

option.description: FFmpeg flag (e.g. -c:v, -crf) OR a virtual option name prefixed with @ (e.g. @text-overlay).

outputFormat.description: Container format for the output file

preset.description: Simple mode — quality/resolution presets. Ignored if `options` is provided.

quality.description: Quality preset — maps to CRF (high=18, medium=23, low=28)

timeoutSeconds.description: Max time to wait for the job to complete, in seconds. Default 600 (10 min). Max 1800.

name: transcode_and_wait
title: Transcode and Wait
